page: Amazon Web Services c5ad.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an AMD EPYC 7R32 x86_64 processor operating at 3.3 GHz, allocating 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of DDR4 system memory running at 3 GHz, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio typical of compute-intensive profiles. In addition to 2 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, this configuration bundles a dedicated 300 GB local NVMe SSD instance store volume. Hardware GPU acceleration is not present on this instance type.

Performance benchmarks establish the instance as an average performer across general compute workloads. It records a Geekbench single-core score of 1335.0 and a multi-core score of 5016.0, alongside a PassMark CPU rating of 10535.71. Clang software compilation measures at 7141.0, while static web serving achieves 7.85 GB/sec and Redis SET operations reach 7.73 million operations per second. However, synthetic stress-ng testing indicates lower relative efficiency, producing 767.49 on single-core and 3040.55 on multi-core runs. Large-block uncached memory operations also show constrained throughput, recording 33.9 GB/sec read and 21.4 GB/sec write bandwidth.

By coupling high-frequency AMD execution cores with high-speed local NVMe storage, the c5ad.2xlarge delivers solid cost efficiency for applications that require fast, direct scratch space without incurring independent cloud volume attachment fees. The absence of AVX-512 extensions and modest uncached memory speed make it less optimal for advanced machine learning inference or heavy vectorized compute. It is most effective for CI/CD build jobs, software compilation, batch processing, API backends, and caching tiers.
description: Amazon Web Services c5ad.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 3.3 GHz AMD EPYC 7R32 processor on the x86_64 architecture. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, it delivers 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores alongside 16.0 GB of DDR4 system memory and an integrated 300 GB local NVMe SSD instance store. The instance includes a 2 Gbps baseline network profile and contains no GPU accelerators. In benchmark evaluations, the c5ad.2xlarge delivers median results across standard tasks, recording 5016.0 in Geekbench multi-core, 7.85 GB/sec in static web throughput, and 7.73 million Redis SET operations per second. While uncached memory bandwidth and stress-ng scores place lower relative to higher-tier configurations, the direct-attached NVMe storage ensures reliable local I/O. The instance is well matched for software compilation, CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, and batch data processing.
